description: TAS Crime Statistics Supplement - 2021-22 is a report listed in the DITRDCSA Data Catalogue under the Regional Data Hub group, published by Department of Police, Fire & Emergency Management, Tasmanian Government. The Department of Police, Fire and Emergency Management Crime Statistics Supplement 2021-22 provides a breakdown of the offences reported or becoming known to police in the financial year ending 30 June 2022. Five-year trend data are included for many of the measures. Data is provided aggregated to the state level and is available in a PDF report. Data includes offence type. Coverage is the states and territories, 2017 to 2022; spatial detail follows the source and is not stated in the entry. The catalogue lists the update frequency as annual, the status as current, and the entry was last changed on 2023-08-15. Files and pages listed: PDF (1 resources), reached from the source page and the catalogue entry, with the CKAN API giving the metadata. Access is free of charge and open; the licence is not stated in the catalogue entry (source page not read). Caveats: the record was written from the catalogue metadata only, so the source page was not opened, the file contents were not checked, and many entries are HTML landing pages or PDF reports, not data files. The subject is social or economic context with only a loose link to infrastructure. It gives regional context for capacity and investment planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-catalogue-australia.
